nina: PRD intake: degraded-mode & burst hedging. Problem: dedicated pools see short 2-5min spikes (promo traffic) that push latency up and cause billing surprises. We need a safe, reversible degraded-mode that preserves core latencies and gives sales visibility into cost.

omar: clarify scope: this is routing/fallback + tenant controls only. Non-goal: changing pricing or autoscaler internals.

tara: proposed goals: (1) define clear acceptance for degraded-mode; (2) per-tenant token caps and cost showback; (3) rollout playbook + runbook.

nina: quick sketch acceptance criteria:
- p99 gateway latency under degraded-mode <= 700ms
- success rate >= 99.5% during sustained 3x baseline for 3m
- per-tenant unit cost increase <= 35% during degraded window
- sampled QA hit-rate >= 95% over 300 prompts

omar: edge cases: simultaneous spikes from multiple tenants, cache churn causing kv-miss storm, tenants with realtime SLAs (exclude them by opt-out). Add hard cap to prevent infinite burst.

tara: mitigation levers: fallback to quantized smaller model, trim optional context, route low-priority requests to delayed queue, per-tenant burst budget.

infra-bot: PRD checklist link: https://redwood.company/prd-template  remember telemetry and billing hooks.

sales-lucy: must export per-tenant cost by model variant for billing UI. CSV or API required.

nina: rollout plan: feature-flag -> canary (3 tenants) 48h -> 20% tenant cohort 24h -> GA if metrics stable. Alerts: p99 > 750ms or cost delta > 50% triggers rollback.

omar: owners: PRD drafter = nina/tara by Mon EOD; dashboards = omar by Tue; billing export = sales-lucy + infra by Wed.

tara: I'll add abuse mitigation (exponential backoff + temporary hold) and sample selection for QA.

nina: ok opening PRD doc now. Please add privacy/regulatory flags if any tenant is excluded. Ping me when you add your sections.
